title: Relief distribution among flood victims in Greater Chittagong
excerpt: A severe flood hit Chittagong in the first week of this month. Extensive areas in Chittagong, Cox's Bazar, and Bandarban were submerged under water. Emergency relief including food, medicine, and clean water was distributed.
body: A severe flood hit Chittagong in the first week of this month. Extensive areas in Chittagong, Cox's Bazar, and Bandarban were inundated with flood waters, rendering thousands of families helpless and displaced. Emergency response teams reached affected communities immediately with emergency food rations, safe drinking water, saline, and necessary medical supplies. Volunteers worked around the clock to ensure relief packages reached the most vulnerable households in remote villages.
author: As-Sunnah Media Team

title: 3rd Imams' Training Completed
excerpt: The 3rd Imams' Training by As-Sunnah Foundation has been successfully completed with the participation of selected Imams from across the country.
body: The 3rd Imams' Training program organised by As-Sunnah Foundation has successfully concluded today. Imams from various districts participated in intensive training sessions focusing on community leadership, social welfare, disaster response management, and Islamic jurisprudence. The program aims to empower local religious leaders to play a proactive role in uplifting their communities.
author: Training Wing

title: Qurbani for All 2024 Project Completed
excerpt: Breaking all past records in bringing smiles to the faces of the country's underprivileged and disaster affected people, the annual Qurbani project was executed smoothly.
body: The Qurbani for All 2024 Project was executed across 64 districts of Bangladesh. Fresh meat packages were distributed to over 150,000 underprivileged households, orphans, and families in flood-affected regions. The meticulous planning, hygienic processing, and door-to-door distribution ensured that the joy of Eid reached every corner of the nation.
author: Relief & Service Wing

title: Community Health Camp in Sylhet Organized
excerpt: A free holistic health camp was organized in Sylhet, providing medical checkups, prescriptions, and free medicine to over 500 underprivileged families.
body: To address healthcare disparities in rural regions, a day-long free community health camp was organized in remote unions of Sylhet district. Specialist doctors provided free consultations in general medicine, gynecology, pediatrics, and eye care. Diagnostic tests and basic medicines were distributed free of charge to more than 500 low-income families.
author: Health Department

title: Youth Empowerment Workshop Held Successfully
excerpt: The workshop focused on skill development, leadership training, and digital literacy, empowering young participants from rural areas.
body: Over 200 young participants gathered for an intensive three-day Youth Empowerment Workshop designed to foster leadership qualities, digital literacy, and entrepreneurial skills. Industry experts conducted interactive sessions on career planning, freelance skills, and ethical business management to help youth become self-reliant.
author: Youth Wing

title: Tree Plantation Drive 2024 Kicks Off Nationwide
excerpt: Over 100,000 fruit-bearing and medicinal saplings are being planted across school campuses, mosques, and riverbanks across Bangladesh.
body: In response to environmental challenges and climate change, a massive nationwide tree plantation campaign was launched. Volunteers and students participated in planting fruit-bearing, shade-providing, and medicinal saplings along roadsides, educational institutions, and river embankments.
author: Environment Team

title: Winter Clothing Distribution Plan Announced
excerpt: Preparations are underway to distribute 50,000 warm blankets and winter clothes to cold-affected northern districts of Bangladesh.
body: With winter approaching, an extensive distribution plan has been finalized to provide warm clothing and heavy blankets to marginalized communities, elderly citizens, and street children living in northern cold-prone districts.
author: Welfare Department

title: Clean Water Deep Tube-Well Installation
excerpt: 120 deep tube-wells have been successfully installed in arsenic-prone coastal areas, granting access to clean drinking water for 30,000 villagers.
body: Access to safe drinking water is a fundamental human right. Over the past quarter, 120 deep tube-wells and solar-powered water filtration plants were established in saline and arsenic-affected coastal villages, providing safe, pure water to thousands of households.
author: Water Project Division

title: Educational Scholarship Awarded to 300 Merit Students
excerpt: Financial aid and learning materials distributed to deserving underprivileged students from primary to university level.
body: To support meritorious students facing extreme financial hardship, stipends and educational kits containing textbooks, uniforms, and stationary were presented. Special grants were also awarded to female students pursuing higher STEM education.
author: Education Council
